summary: Eni S.p.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting treasury share purchases from August 3-7, 2026, under its buyback program approved by shareholders on May 6, 2026. Eni acquired 4,910,770 shares (0.16% of share capital) at a weighted average price of €23.4179 per share, totaling €114,999,971.73. Since the program began, Eni has repurchased 53,523,480 shares (1.77%) for €1,189,916,148.47, now holding 4.64%. The buyback aims to provide additional shareholder remuneration beyond dividends. Watch for continued execution pace and impact on share price support.
